metaDescription: Learn how to switch TradingView to dark mode from the theme settings menu, useful for late-night charting on PC, Android, or iPhone.
intro: Dark mode gives TradingView a sleeker, easier-on-the-eyes interface that's especially useful during late-night charting sessions. This guide covers finding the theme settings and toggling dark mode on or off.

steps.heading: Open the account menu
steps.body: Click the logo or account icon in the upper left corner of the TradingView window to open the drop-down menu.

steps.heading: Find the theme settings
steps.body: Scroll through the menu options to locate the dark theme setting among other display and personalization preferences.

steps.heading: Toggle dark theme on
steps.body: Click the dark theme toggle to instantly switch your interface from light to dark mode.

steps.heading: Confirm the change applied
steps.body: Your TradingView interface should immediately reflect the new dark theme across charts and menus.

steps.heading: Switch back to light mode if needed
steps.body: Follow the same steps and toggle the setting again to revert to light mode whenever you prefer.

steps.heading: Works across devices
steps.body: This toggle is available whether you're using TradingView on PC, or the Android and iPhone apps.

faq.question: Where do I find dark mode on TradingView?
faq.answer: Open the account menu from the upper left corner and look for the dark theme toggle among the display settings.

faq.question: Can I switch back to light mode later?
faq.answer: Yes, simply follow the same steps and toggle the theme setting again to switch back.

faq.question: Does dark mode work on mobile apps too?
faq.answer: Yes, dark mode can be enabled or disabled on the Android and iPhone TradingView apps as well as on PC.

faq.question: Does dark mode save battery on mobile?
faq.answer: Dark mode can help conserve battery life on devices with OLED screens, in addition to reducing eye strain.

faq.question: Will dark mode change my chart colors too?
faq.answer: Dark mode primarily changes the interface theme, though chart background settings can be adjusted separately.
